src: template-color marker pixels s in the middle band (between top templates and bottom palette)
dst: stamp slots d in an N×N grid of N×N tiles
match_cond: s.color == template_color[j]; d.pos == (s.r mod N, s.c mod N)
transform: replace d with template_mask[j] recolored to palette_color[j] (palette read from bottom band, left→right aligned to template columns)
